about: FDA advisory committee votes on named drug and biologic applications since 2020. Each vote count is quoted from the FDA's own minutes (vote_source_type fda) or the sponsor's release (sponsor); each FDA action from an FDA record (fda) or the sponsor's filing (sponsor). public_note is written by pdufa.bio from those documents. Rendered by build_adcomm_votes.py.
